slug: 2025-01-17 Zambia Advances Digital ID System with MOSIP Training for Healthcare Integration

facts.fact: SMART Zambia developers were trained on integrating MOSIP with the SmartCarePro electronic health record system, aimed at identity verification using National Registration Card data, and Zambia is preparing to launch an open-source eKYC system on MOSIP, per ID Tech.

facts.fact: SMART Zambia has been piloting MOSIP's e-Signet tool since mid-2024 to connect the country's digital ID to public services with biometric authentication.

The Smart Zambia Institute is piloting MOSIP's EET (e-Signet) to connect existing biometric ID databases with digital services for eKYC and authentication, with drought relief management named as its first use.
Co-Develop says the eKYC platform verifies identity against the NRC number and has been extended to emergency drought relief and electronic health records.
Co-Develop says the NRC-based eKYC is used for emergency drought relief and for electronic health records.

Bank of Zambia says Home Affairs charges banks about 80 cents per successful API call to verify against its database.
